SignIn.tagline: A more human way to connect
SignIn.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. You can still sign in with your email below.
SignIn.checkEmail: Check {email} for a magic link to sign in.
SignIn.verificationRetry: Verification check didn't load. Try again.

errors.captchaFailed: We couldn't verify you're not a robot. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.connection: Something went wrong. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.linkExpired: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Request a new link and use the newest email.
errors.signInFailed: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.
errors.verificationRequired: Please complete the verification check, then try again.
errors.googleStartFailed: Could not start Google sign-in. Please try again.
errors.googleSignInFailed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
errors.googleCaptchaFailed: Please complete the security check again, then continue with Google.
errors.googleSecurityCheckPending: Complete the security check below to finish signing in with Google.

refusals.deleted: This account was deleted and can’t be restored. If you’d like to return to Tempa, you’ll need to create a new account.
refusals.banned: This account has been permanently banned from Tempa and can no longer be used to sign in. If you believe this is a mistake, contact {email}.
refusals.deletedUnavailable: This account was deleted and can’t be restored. A new account can’t be created with it at the moment. If you believe this is a mistake, contact {email}.
refusals.unavailable: This account can’t be used to sign in to Tempa. If you believe this is a mistake, contact {email}.

LanguageSettings.heading: Language

LanguageSettings.error: Could not save right now. Please try again.
LanguageSettings.translationIntro: The language Tempa translates other people’s writing into when you ask.
